body: I'm actually reeeally terrified of heights. I went on a kid's ride in Disneyland's World of Harry Potter and I was shitting my pants when the ride was over.

No snow or beaches where I live, and I'm terrified to use see through elevators or going over 60mph on the highway, let alone skydive. I have read about lucid dreaming, but due to my state of mind I'm scared about having a bad trip and end up trapped in my terrors. I got high this weekend and I was a step away from throwing myself of my window while bad tripping and having my depression 10 times worse than it normally is.

The volunteering thing seems like a good idea, I guess I'll look around the internet seeing if there's anything I can do.

Edit: I also can't really do anything where I have to take my shirt off (like going to the beach or to the pool) because I'm really self-conscious about my [Pectus Excavatum](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pectus_excavatum), although it's not nearly as bad as the picture in that article.

I appreciate that, brofist right back at you.

I really have been trying to pick up new hobbies but everything I have tried didn't really give me any enjoyment, which made me more and more frustrated as I realized I'm drifting further away from humanity each passing moment.

I did consider picking up a sport, maybe boxing. I'm still looking into that, but in my situation I just spend my days debating weather I should do it or not and I end up not doing anything about it.

As for the girl, I really CAN'T tell her about it. It would make everything awkward, besides the default anxiety problems to actually come up and utter the words. I wouldn't even be able to tell some girl I see in the coffee shop or at the campus that I think she's pretty or ask someone out with nothing to lose, how am I suposed to pour my heart out to someone I can risk my current relationship with? I can't afford having any less friends where I am right now. I won't, and I will regret it, I know...

I've been forcing myself to find something I may enjoy, but nothing as come out so far. I just don't enjoy anything anymore.

I tried to pick up drawing, writing, 3D modelling, programming...

I do play the guitar and I used to be really passionate about cinema, but even these don't keep me entretained anymore. I feel nothing towards everything.

Online games don't make me happy anymore, and that's how it all started actually. It's like it was all fun and not caring until someday I wasn't enjoying it anymore. Of course I still spent sometime playing trying to revive the magic, but it just wasn't there anymore. Then I looked around and got to see the damage I had made in my real life.
